pages: Ollie cannot find his glasses.
"Where are my glasses?" he says.
He looks under the bed. Not there.
He looks in the kitchen. Not there.
He looks behind the sofa. Not there.
"I cannot see without my glasses!" says Ollie.
Nong Fah comes to help.
She looks at Ollie and starts to laugh.
"Ollie! Look up!" she says.
The glasses are on top of his head!
"Oh my!" says Ollie. "They were with me all the time!"
Thawan has a new kite. It is red and yellow.
He runs, and the kite flies up, up, up!
"Look at my kite!" says Thawan.
Then a big wind comes. Whoosh!
The kite flies away!
Thawan and Nong Fah run after it.
They run past the school. They run past the shop.
The kite falls down at the pond.
The little duck picks it up with her beak.
"Thank you, Duck!" says Thawan.
Now they all fly the kite together.
Cat lives with Nong Fah. Duck lives at the pond.
One day, Cat walks to the pond.
"Hello," says Cat. "Can you play?"
"Yes!" says Duck. "Let's play in the water!"
"Oh no," says Cat. "Cats do not like water."
Duck thinks and thinks.
"Then let's play in the grass!" says Duck.
They run and jump in the grass all day.
Cat is happy. Duck is happy.
New friends can always find a way to play.
Rain, rain, rain! The friends cannot play outside.
"I am bored," says Thawan.
"I have an idea!" says Nong Fah.
They take blankets from the bed.
They take pillows from the sofa.
They build a big fort in the living room!
Ollie flies in with cookies and milk.
They read books inside the fort.
The rain goes tap, tap, tap on the window.
It is the best rainy day ever!
Nong Fah plants a little seed.
She waters it every day.
One day. Two days. Three days. Nothing!
"Grow, little seed, grow!" she says.
"You must wait," says Ollie. "Seeds need time."
Nong Fah waits and waters. Waits and waters.
One morning, she sees something green!
It is a little plant!
It grows bigger and bigger.
Soon there is a big pink flower.
"I did it!" says Nong Fah. "I grew a flower!"
The school show is today.
Thawan will sing a song.
But Thawan is scared. "There are so many people!"
His hands shake. His tummy feels funny.
"You can do it," says Nong Fah.
"We will be right here," says Ollie.
Thawan walks up. He sees his friends smiling.
He takes a big breath and sings.
His voice is loud and clear!
Everyone claps and claps.
"I did it!" says Thawan. "I was brave!"
Ollie loves to bake cookies.
He bakes one plate. Then two plates. Then three!
"Oh no," says Ollie. "That is too many cookies!"
He thinks and thinks.
"I know! I will share them!"
He gives cookies to Nong Fah and Thawan.
He gives cookies to Cat, Duck, and Frog.
Soon all the cookies are gone.
But everyone is smiling.
"Sharing is the best part of baking," says Ollie.
Today is the big race!
Thawan is fast. Frog can jump far.
"Ready, set, go!" says Ollie.
Thawan runs fast. Frog jumps and jumps.
Then — oh no! Thawan trips and falls.
Frog stops jumping.
He goes back to help Thawan up.
"Thank you, Frog," says Thawan.
They run to the finish line together.
They finish at the same time!
"You are both winners," says Ollie.
It is bedtime, but where is Cat?
Nong Fah looks in the kitchen. No Cat.
She looks under the bed. No Cat.
She looks behind the door. No Cat.
"Cat! Where are you?" she calls.
Then she hears a little sound. Purr, purr.
She opens the basket of clean clothes.
There is Cat, fast asleep on the warm shirts!
"Oh, Cat," laughs Nong Fah.
She carries Cat to bed, and they sleep all night.
Tomorrow is Nong Fah's birthday.
"Let's make a surprise party!" says Thawan.
"Shh! It is a secret," says Ollie.
Thawan makes a big card.
Ollie bakes a yellow cake.
Cat, Duck, and Frog put up balloons.
They all hide in the living room.
Nong Fah opens the door.
"SURPRISE!" everyone shouts.
Nong Fah jumps! Then she laughs and laughs.
"This is the best birthday ever!" she says.
Happy birthday, Nong Fah!
